name: Canh cá
summary: Canh cá is fish soup in the daily rice. The Hội An World Heritage centre’s 16 September 2025 study lists it with the other simple fish plates and says the island kitchen uses little spice. No recipe and no stall price were printed.
origin: Cham Islands. The daily catch on Tân Hiệp, eaten with rice.
howToEat: With rice, at the midday or evening meal. The 16 September 2025 study puts lunch at about 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal at about 17:00–18:00.
The study does not name a fish, a herb, or a souring fruit. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Bai Lang and the other hamlets. The study names no shop.
seoTitle: Canh cá — fish soup on the Cham Islands
seoDescription: Fish soup in the daily rice on Tân Hiệp, with little spice. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00. A stall price is Check on arrival.
